_doc: Which canonical jobs (game/data/canonical/jobs.json) are playable in this build and what advancing grants (docs/GAME_DESIGN.md section 9). A job missing here is not playable with default_reason. Optional level overrides the canonical advancement level for survivor mode; an option above the player's level shows level_reason instead. grants.items ([item ids], optional, spec #151 owner change) are Equip items handed over at the advancement: they join the Equip tab after the displaced weapon, and any that find no free slot lie at the player's feet as normal pickups, so advancing never fails. grants.max_mp adds to computed base Max MP (Improved MaxMP Increase preserves the current MP ratio on growth). grants.max_hp (added to base Max HP, like level growth) is supported alongside max_mp. format1_weapon (tier C, frozen spec #32 rule) is the weapon CharacterSnapshot.migrate gives a format-1 character of that job line, the nearest ancestor's entry; new jobs need none. paths (first jobs, spec #151 #157): [{id, label, item_id, family}], one job-window entry each; taking one records it on the character (snapshot weapon_path) and grants and wears its item_id without requirement checks (tier B Beginner weapons given by the instructors; Warrior has none: its sword is balance.player.weapon_grants like the Magician's Wooden Wand). weapon_families + grant_item (second jobs): the families the branch can use and the weapon worn when the held one is not among them (tier C); grant_item ids are chosen by the class specs, so a row without one grants nothing. No job grants skills. Accepting a job opens an extra advancement skill draw before the level's normal draw; canonical skill prerequisites are ignored (tier C owner choice #31).

100._provenance: tier B: first-job Max HP +200-250 (Cosmic changeJob, v83-facts 4), fixed midpoint; tier C: first-job advancement at Lv 10 (owner choice, spec #151 #163). Weapons (owner change after the spec): the Beginner Warrior's sword 1302077 is worn (balance.player.weapon_grants; tier B: the Cosmic instructor script gift, PAD 30, reqLv 10), the old creation weapon goes to the Equip tab, and grants.items adds a Lv 10 Spear 1432000 (PAD 32, reqJob 13, no stat need) and a Lv 10 Steel Pipe 1322006 (one-handed blunt, PAD 29, reqJob 0, no stat need), tier C choice: the plain shop weapons of the Warrior-usable spear and blunt families at reqLevel 10 that need no STR a Lv 10 Warrior might lack (the Iron Hammer 1322032 would need STR 35). Growth and AP: balance.json growth/ap_stat "100".
